#### Brain Region
```{r}
# Design and contrast
region.design <- ~ RIN + miRcountLog + Sex + Race + PrimaryDx + BrainRegion + (1 | BrNum)  # Random intercept only. With just 3 samples per subject, a random slope for region (BrainRegion | Subject) will usually fail to converge...

# Contrasts must be passed to dream() at fit time via L.
# Dream automatically appends all univariate contrasts: make additional contrasts to calculate all pairwise region comparisons. 
region.contr <- setNames(c("BrainRegionHIPPO - BrainRegionmPFC", "BrainRegionHIPPO - BrainRegionCaudate", "BrainRegionmPFC - BrainRegionCaudate"), c("HIPPO_vs_mPFC", "HIPPO_vs_Caudate", "mPFC_vs_Caudate"))

L <- makeContrastsDream(region.design, sampleSheet, contrasts = region.contr)
plotContrasts(L) # sanity-check the +1/-1 encoding

# Fit and moderate s.d.
region.fit <- dream(miRcount.vst, region.design, tibble::column_to_rownames(sampleSheet, "RNum_miRNA"), L = L) # dream assumes y follows normal distribution...
region.fit <- eBayes(region.fit)

# Test
colnames(region.fit)
region.res <- topTable(region.fit, coef = c("BrainRegionHIPPO", "BrainRegionmPFC", "BrainRegionCaudate"), number = Inf, sort.by = "none") # differences across regions
hist(region.res$P.Value)
table(region.res$adj.P.Val<0.01) # 911
```

effect size
```{r}
# mean expression in each brain region
for (r in c("DLPFC", "mPFC", "HIPPO", "Caudate")) {
  region.res[,r] = rowMeans(miRcount.vst.lmCov5res[, subset(sampleSheet, BrainRegion == r)$RNum_miRNA])
}

# find lowest and highest regions for every miRNA
region.res$lowest.tissue = c("DLPFC", "mPFC", "HIPPO", "Caudate")[apply(region.res[, c("DLPFC", "mPFC", "HIPPO", "Caudate")], 1, which.min)]
region.res$highest.tissue = c("DLPFC", "mPFC", "HIPPO", "Caudate")[apply(region.res[, c("DLPFC", "mPFC", "HIPPO", "Caudate")], 1, which.max)]

# calculate max diff. among pairwise comparisons.
temp = as.matrix(region.res[,c("DLPFC", "mPFC", "HIPPO", "Caudate")]) # get a "matrix" for subsetting.
region.res$maxDiff = temp[cbind(1:nrow(temp), match(region.res$highest.tissue, colnames(temp)))]-temp[cbind(1:nrow(temp), match(region.res$lowest.tissue, colnames(temp)))]
```

significant miRNAs
```{r}
with(region.res, table(adj.P.Val<0.01 & maxDiff>0.5)) # 67

# Fig. 1B
temp = subset(region.res, adj.P.Val<0.01 & maxDiff>0.5)  %>% dplyr::select(DLPFC, mPFC, HIPPO, Caudate)

pheatmap::pheatmap(temp, scale = "row", cluster_cols = F, fontsize_row = 6, width=7, height=6)
```

Region specificity
```{r}
cohen_d2 <- function(x, group_labels, target_group) { # target group vs second highest group
  
  group_means = data.frame(value = x, group = group_labels) %>% group_by(group) %>% summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  cont_group = as.character(group_means$group[which(order(group_means$mean_value, decreasing = T)==2)])
  
  x_target <- x[group_labels %in% target_group]
  x_cont   <- x[group_labels %in% cont_group]
  
  n1 <- length(x_target)
  n2 <- length(x_cont)
  
  mean1 <- mean(x_target, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean2 <- mean(x_cont, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Pooled SD
  sd1 <- sd(x_target, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd2 <- sd(x_cont, na.rm = TRUE)
  s_pooled <- sqrt(((n1 - 1)*sd1^2 + (n2 - 1)*sd2^2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
  
  d <- (mean1 - mean2) / s_pooled
  return(d)
}

# cohen_d2
region.res$pfcSpecific2=sapply(rownames(region.res), function(x) {cohen_d2(miRcount.vst.lmCov5res[x,], sampleSheet$BrainRegion, c("DLPFC", "mPFC"))})

region.res$hippoSpecific2=sapply(rownames(region.res), function(x) {cohen_d2(miRcount.vst.lmCov5res[x,], sampleSheet$BrainRegion, "HIPPO")})

region.res$caudateSpecific2=sapply(rownames(region.res), function(x) {cohen_d2(miRcount.vst.lmCov5res[x,], sampleSheet$BrainRegion, "Caudate")})
```

#### DLPFC 3 disorders
```{r}
tempSheet = subset(sampleSheet, BrainRegion=="DLPFC")
nrow(tempSheet) # 360
rownames(tempSheet)=NULL

# DE design (no random effect, equivalent to limma lmFit)
dlpfcDisease.design <- ~ RIN + miRcountLog + Sex + Race + PrimaryDx

dlpfcDisease.contr <- setNames(c("PrimaryDxSchizo - PrimaryDxBipolar", "PrimaryDxSchizo - PrimaryDxMDD", "PrimaryDxBipolar - PrimaryDxMDD"), c("Schizo_vs_Bipolar", "Schizo_vs_MDD", "Bipolar_vs_MDD"))

L <- makeContrastsDream(dlpfcDisease.design, tempSheet, contrasts = dlpfcDisease.contr)
plotContrasts(L)

# Fit and moderate
dlpfcDisease.fit <- dream(miRcount.vst[, tempSheet$RNum_miRNA], dlpfcDisease.design, tibble::column_to_rownames(tempSheet, "RNum_miRNA"), L = L)

dlpfcDisease.fit <- eBayes(dlpfcDisease.fit)

# Test
colnames(dlpfcDisease.fit)
dlpfcDisease.res <- topTable(dlpfcDisease.fit, coef = c("PrimaryDxSchizo","PrimaryDxBipolar", "PrimaryDxMDD"), number = Inf, sort.by = "none") 
hist(dlpfcDisease.res$P.Value)
table(dlpfcDisease.res$adj.P.Val<0.01) # 17

# Pair-wise log2FC
temp <- lapply(c("PrimaryDxSchizo", "PrimaryDxBipolar", "PrimaryDxMDD", names(dlpfcDisease.contr)), function(cf) { topTable(dlpfcDisease.fit, coef = cf, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") })

dlpfcDisease.log2fc <- purrr::map(temp, "logFC") %>% bind_cols()
colnames(dlpfcDisease.log2fc) = c("Schizo_vs_DLPFC", "Bipolar_vs_DLPFC", "MDD_vs_DLPFC", names(dlpfcDisease.contr))

# absolute max of log2FC
dlpfcDisease.res$logFC <- apply(dlpfcDisease.log2fc, 1, function(x) x[which.max(abs(x))])
```

### Roadmap Brain chromHMM

This code was copied from freeze082825_enrichment.Rmd

```{r}
# intersection
for (region in c("dlpfc", "mpfc", "hippo", "caudate")) {
  for (race in c("cauc", "aa")) {
    temp = miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]][ ,c("variant_chrom", "variant_pos")] %>% mutate(chrom=paste0("chr", variant_chrom), start=variant_pos, end=variant_pos) %>% dplyr::select(chrom, start, end) %>% as("GRanges")
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(chromhmm.table)) {
      miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]][[paste0("chromhmm.", chromhmm.table$Annotation[i])]] = temp %over% subset(chromhmm, name==chromhmm.table$Annotation[i])
    }
  }
}

# test
miRqtl.lead.enrich.chromhmm = list()

for (region in c("dlpfc", "mpfc", "hippo", "caudate")) {
  for (race in c("cauc", "aa")) {
    miRqtl.lead.enrich.chromhmm[[paste0(region, ".", race)]] = data.frame(BrainRegion=region, Race=race, Type=chromhmm.table$Annotation, enrich_est=rep(NA, nrow(chromhmm.table)), enrich_pval=rep(NA, nrow(chromhmm.table)))

    for (i in 1:nrow(chromhmm.table)) {
      temp = glm(sig ~ get(paste0("chromhmm.", chromhmm.table$Annotation[i])) + factor(maf_group), data = mutate(miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]], sig=fdr<0.05, maf_group=cut(maf, breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5))), family = binomial) %>% summary() # logistic regression
      miRqtl.lead.enrich.chromhmm[[paste0(region, ".", race)]][i, c(4,5)] = temp$coefficients[2,c(1,4)]
    }
  }
}

miRqtl.lead.enrich.chromhmm = do.call(rbind, miRqtl.lead.enrich.chromhmm)

# heatmap
temp = mutate(subset(miRqtl.lead.enrich.chromhmm, Race=="CAUC"), y=-log10(enrich_pval)) %>% dcast(., BrainRegion~Type, value.var = "y") %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("BrainRegion")

pheatmap::pheatmap(temp, cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F, fontsize_row = 11, fontsize_col = 11, width=7, height=5)
```

### Brain cell-type enhancer

This code was copied from freeze082825_enrichment.Rmd

```{r}
# intersection
for (region in c("dlpfc", "mpfc", "hippo", "caudate")) {
  for (race in c("cauc", "aa")) {
    temp = miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]][ ,c("variant_chrom", "variant_pos")] %>% mutate(chrom=paste0("chr", variant_chrom), start=variant_pos-1, end=variant_pos) %>% dplyr::select(chrom, start, end) %>% as("GRanges")
    
    miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]]$enhancer.neuron = temp %over% nott.enhancer[["neuron"]]
    miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]]$enhancer.oligo = temp %over% nott.enhancer[["oligo"]]
    miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]]$enhancer.lhx2 = temp %over% nott.enhancer[["lhx2"]]
    miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]]$enhancer.pu1 = temp %over% nott.enhancer[["pu1"]]
  }
}

# enrichment test
miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer = list()

for (region in c("dlpfc", "mpfc", "hippo", "caudate")) {
  for (race in c("cauc", "aa")) {
    miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer[[paste0(region, ".", race)]] = data.frame(BrainRegion=region, Race=race, Type=c("Neuron", "Oligo", "LHX2", "PU1"), enrich_est=c(NA, NA, NA, NA), enrich_pval=c(NA, NA, NA, NA))
    
    temp = glm(sig ~ enhancer.neuron + factor(maf_group), data = mutate(miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]], sig=fdr<0.05, maf_group=cut(maf, breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5))), family = binomial) %>% summary() # logistic regression
    miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer[[paste0(region, ".", race)]][1, c(4,5)] = temp$coefficients[2,c(1,4)]
    
    temp = glm(sig ~ enhancer.oligo + factor(maf_group), data = mutate(miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]], sig=fdr<0.05, maf_group=cut(maf, breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5))), family = binomial) %>% summary()
    miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer[[paste0(region, ".", race)]][2, c(4,5)] = temp$coefficients[2,c(1,4)]
    
    temp = glm(sig ~ enhancer.lhx2 + factor(maf_group), data = mutate(miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]], sig=fdr<0.05, maf_group=cut(maf, breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5))), family = binomial) %>% summary()
    miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer[[paste0(region, ".", race)]][3, c(4,5)] = temp$coefficients[2,c(1,4)]
    
    temp = glm(sig ~ enhancer.pu1 + factor(maf_group), data = mutate(miRqtl.lead.list[[paste0(region, ".", race)]], sig=fdr<0.05, maf_group=cut(maf, breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5))), family = binomial) %>% summary()
    miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer[[paste0(region, ".", race)]][4, c(4,5)] = temp$coefficients[2,c(1,4)]
  }
}
miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer = do.call(rbind, miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer)

# Bar plot
miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer$BrainRegion = factor(miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer$BrainRegion, levels=c("dlpfc", "mpfc", "hippo", "caudate"), labels=c("DLPFC", "mPFC", "Hippocampus", "Caudate"))
miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer$Race = factor(miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer$Race, levels=c("cauc", "aa"), labels=c("CAUC", "AA"))
miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer$Type = factor(miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer$Type, levels=c("Neuron", "Oligo", "LHX2", "PU1"))

p = ggplot(miRqtl.lead.enrich.enhancer, aes(x=BrainRegion, y=-log10(enrich_pval), fill=Type)) + facet_grid(Race~.)
p = p + geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge())
p
```

#### GARFIELD

We used GARFIELD software package. See details in the methods section.

#### Host-miRNA

colocalization between host RNA and miRNA was calculated in freeze082825_host_cleaned.Rmd

```{r}
temp = subset(miRqtl.host2, emir)
nrow(temp) # 445
temp$coloc.sig = FALSE
temp$coloc.sig[which(temp$coloc.h4>0.5)] = TRUE
table(temp$coloc.sig) # 34
with(subset(temp, coloc.sig), unique(paste(miRgeID, gene_id))) %>% length() # 16

temp = temp %>% mutate(race = recode(race, "cauc" = "WA", "aa"   = "BA"), region = recode(region, "caudate"="Caudate", "dlpfc"="DLPFC", "hippo"="Hippocampus", "mpfc"="mPFC"))
  
p = ggplot(temp, aes(x=corr, col=coloc.sig))+facet_grid(race~region)
p = p + stat_ecdf(linewidth=1)
p = p + scale_color_manual(values=c("black", "red"))
p = p + labs(x="Correlation between miRNA and host mRNA", y="Cumulative proportion")
p = p + theme_pubr(legend="right") + labs_pubr() + cowplot::background_grid()
p
```
